interventions.detail: Installed torch==2.13.0/torchvision from the PyTorch CPU wheel index instead of the default CUDA build
Added triton==3.8.0: remote code imports triton at module level, so transformers check_imports fails without it
Replaced hardcoded .cuda() on images_seq_mask in modeling_unlimitedocr.py with .to(inputs_embeds.device)
Cast image tensors (hardcoded bfloat16) to the model dtype in _uocr_generate so fp32 CPU inference works
Pinned the model revision, wrote refs/main, and set HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 so the patched cached remote code is used
